title: SpeakGrade eval labels
description: Schema for apps/api/eval/labels.json. One entry per labelled speech in the eval seed set. See notes/eval-harness-deep-dive.md for what each field is for.

id.description: Stable identifier for this case. Becomes the row label in the eval table.

source.description: fixture = pre-built Transcript/Metrics in tests/fixtures.py. audio = .wav under eval/audio/.

fixture_name.description: Required when source=fixture. Must match a GoldenCase symbol exported from apps/api/tests/fixtures.py (e.g. FILLERY_FAST).

audio_path.description: Required when source=audio. Relative to apps/api/eval/ (e.g. 'audio/mid_band.wav').

speech_type.description: Passed through to the pipeline. Affects scoring weights (impromptu drops `closing`).

graded_by.description: Who graded this case (a name, or 'DRAFT — ...' for placeholders).

graded_at.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) when graded. Null while still a draft.

notes.description: Free-text grading notes — why you scored a category the way you did, what was hard to judge, etc. Kept for future-you reviewing the eval table.

score.description: 1 (needs work) through 5 (excellent), or 'n/a' if the category doesn't apply.
